data.title: Bezalel Smotrich remained in government to preserve Operation Rising Lion, he claims | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: He voted against the January 2025 hostage deal, his own voters demanded he resign, and Ben-Gvir walked out. Smotrich stayed silent for five months. In an interview with the Post, he explained why.
